title: Peripheral probe specification (phase 7)
description: Declares the expected result AND the plausibility band. A result that is implausibly good is a FAIL, not a pass: an e-paper refresh that 'succeeded' in 29 ms had an unpowered controller and a floating BUSY line. Consumed by probe_client.py, which is not part of the M0-M5 core build; the schema ships now so phase 7 data has a shape.

preconditions.description: State that must be established and settled BEFORE the sequence. Most implausible successes are a missing precondition, not a flake.

i2c_addresses.description: The EXACT expected address set, not a superset. Finding an extra device is as interesting as missing one.

plausibility.description: Bounds on every measurement. Never widen a band to make a test pass - that is the electronics equivalent of wrapping a fillet in try/except.

requires_transition.description: A steady-state observation never proves a subsystem is alive. Demand a counter that increments or a level that moves.

retry_allowed.description: Default false. A retry that sometimes works is a wiring fault, not a flake.
